title: Segway through Sevilla
text: Emilio was knowledgeable and the weather was great two factors that made the experience so enjoyable
author: Zeina_K

title: Segway in Seville
text: This was a super fun tour! Our segways were ready and our tour guide, Miriam, took the best care of us as we zipped around the streets of Sevilla! She was very knowledgeable in all things Sevilla! Highly recommend it…
author: Rebecca_Q

title: Highly recommended BUT for daytime
text: Although our night segway tour was a fail but the company made up for the shortcomings. I booked this night tour to make the most of my first evening in Seville but unfortunately, city had a parade that night causing one of the main streets in town to be blocked and then one of our Segway’s battery died. Our tour guide was very courteous and nice. We were immediately offered a time of our choosing for the next morning which turned out to be a blessing in disguise. Next day was bright & sunny and Seville is much better during daylight. I’d highly recommend this tour but for day time.
author: TJ_Khizri
